description: This file defines the 'FormsLockedException' class, a custom exception used within the OpenMRS API to indicate that form operations are blocked due to forms being locked, typically related to a global property setting.

classes.name: FormsLockedException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending APIException, indicating that forms are locked and cannot be modified or deleted.

methods.description: Default constructor initializing the exception with a standard message indicating forms are locked.
